object.place_model: one canonical public-safe place, source run, seven-aperture bundle, eight-overlay bundle, and design constitution
object.claim_boundary: These records project one admitted public-safe place through five functional seats. They are not simulated personalities, private household records, field observations, offers, eligibility decisions, work authorizations, completed-remediation receipts, public releases, or canonical task-row transitions.

common_law: Every role consumes the same place identity and source-run lineage.
A role changes evidence, controls, authority, acceptance, export, and handoff rather than only changing labels.
Missing, stale, map-only, authored, and degraded evidence remain visible inside every projection that consumes them.
A safe action is a bounded internal next step, not entry, inspection, labor, payment, publication, representation, or another external effect.
Authority does not transfer merely because evidence is visible to a role.
Exports retain source, state, uncertainty, authority, prohibited-consequence, and no-effect fields.
Affected actors retain acceptance, refusal, correction, and appeal where applicable.
The successor role proves replay and continuity, not release authority.
adverse_action_boundary: No role projection may create insurance, underwriting, premium, enforcement, property, resident, eligibility, evacuation, safety, work-completion, or other adverse standing.

roles.label: Resident
roles.operating_purpose: Review public context and authored household-scale questions, correct what does not match lived experience, and accept, refuse, narrow, or defer any later proposal.
controls: inspect source and authored evidence separately
mark a statement correct, incorrect, unknown, or not applicable
record a private correction locally without publishing it
accept, refuse, narrow, or defer a later bounded proposal
roles.reading: The resident projection prioritizes lived use, care burden, access, comfort, pets, tools, and household agency while public and authored context remains non-diagnostic.
safe_actions: review the evidence and identify one bounded question that requires private confirmation
prepare a local correction or acceptance record without sending or publishing it
roles.authority: The affected resident controls private correction, consent, refusal, and acceptance. The projection grants no authority to inspect, enter, schedule, pay, publish, or represent.
roles.acceptance: The resident can identify the source, uncertainty, proposed action, held effects, and the exact point at which explicit resident acceptance would later be required.
roles.export_contract: Export a resident-review packet containing only the selected public evidence, authored questions, local corrections, authority limits, and explicit non-release state.
roles.handoff: Hand off only a resident-selected question, correction, or accepted scope together with its source and consent boundary; never transfer the private record by implication.
roles.failure_state: When lived confirmation or consent is absent, hold the claim and preserve the unanswered question rather than substituting public context or an authored demonstration.
roles.prohibited_consequence: No household score, resident ranking, entry authority, work order, eligibility result, insurance consequence, enforcement action, or public representation.

roles.label: Nursery or Grower
roles.operating_purpose: Relate plant, care, shade, heat, and water evidence to a bounded cultivation option without diagnosing a real plant or prescribing care from unavailable observations.
controls: compare source-backed context with authored care questions
prepare a non-binding plant or material option
state required resident and field confirmation
define nursery acceptance and substitution limits
roles.reading: The nursery or grower projection turns plant and environmental context into options, availability questions, and care constraints while diagnosis and real-site fitness remain held.
safe_actions: prepare an option set with source, uncertainty, and substitution rules
request the minimum resident or field observation needed before recommending a real intervention
roles.authority: The nursery or grower may prepare options and explain material characteristics. It may not diagnose, promise availability, enter a property, authorize work, or bind a resident or program.
roles.acceptance: The option identifies its intended use, exclusions, source dates, substitution rule, resident confirmation, and the evidence needed before it could become a real recommendation.
roles.export_contract: Export a cultivation-option packet with selected plant and environmental evidence, candidate options, substitution limits, required observations, and no-order status.
roles.handoff: Hand off a bounded option and its assumptions to the resident or steward; do not convert an option into an order, prescription, availability claim, or completed-care record.
roles.failure_state: When plant condition, resident use, inventory, or field fitness is unknown, retain the option as conditional and name the missing observation or availability check.
roles.prohibited_consequence: No diagnosis, watering command, pesticide instruction, purchase, inventory promise, site-fitness claim, work authorization, or completion claim.

roles.label: Crew or Property Steward
roles.operating_purpose: Prepare source-linked access, verification, sequencing, equipment, and acceptance questions for later lawful field work without claiming a physical condition or authorizing execution.
controls: review map-only, source-backed, and authored geometry as separate classes
prepare a verification route and access question
identify equipment, safety, and consent prerequisites
define execution and completion evidence before work begins
roles.reading: The crew or steward projection emphasizes access, source registration, work boundaries, field verification, sequencing, and acceptance while physical identity and lawful entry remain unknown.
safe_actions: prepare a no-entry verification plan tied to exact source and geometry receipts
list the consent, safety, equipment, and completion evidence required before any real work
roles.authority: The crew or steward may prepare an internal verification and work-readiness question. It has no entry, traffic, pruning, labor, safety, equipment, scheduling, or completion authority.
roles.acceptance: The preparation record separates known public context from unknown physical conditions and names lawful access, resident acceptance, competent review, execution, and completion receipts.
roles.export_contract: Export a steward-preparation packet containing source and registration receipts, proposed verification sequence, prerequisites, held effects, and explicit no-entry and no-work status.
roles.handoff: Hand off a verification question or accepted scope to the accountable resident, provider, or program operator; never hand off a fabricated physical finding or implied work order.
roles.failure_state: When access, physical identity, safety, equipment, or consent is unknown, hold execution and preserve the exact missing prerequisite rather than inferring readiness from imagery.
roles.prohibited_consequence: No entry, inspection, traffic control, pruning, digging, labor, equipment deployment, safety determination, work order, remediation, or completion claim.

roles.label: Planner or Public Program
roles.operating_purpose: Relate neighborhood and regional conditions to bounded assistance, source repair, coordination, and offer preparation without creating a punitive score or an eligibility decision.
controls: compare regional source state without collapsing it into a parcel score
route source repair, verification, or assistance preparation
prepare an offer with authority, resources, refusal, and appeal
record accountable review before any external effect
roles.reading: The planner or program projection widens from local context to shared routes, source health, incidents, resources, and assistance while household condition and eligibility remain unproved.
safe_actions: prepare a source-repair, verification, or assistance-routing question
draft a bounded offer record that still requires accountable human review and affected-actor acceptance
roles.authority: The planner or program operator may coordinate internal review and prepare a bounded offer. It may not determine eligibility, funding, insurance, enforcement, property condition, or resident standing.
roles.acceptance: The program record identifies source scope, affected actor, lawful authority, resources, refusal and appeal, execution owner, acceptance criteria, and all prohibited consequences.
roles.export_contract: Export an assistance-preparation packet with regional and local source states, proposed offer terms, accountable review requirements, appeal route, and no-award and no-adverse-action status.
roles.handoff: Hand off a source-repair request, verification question, or reviewed offer to the affected actor and accountable operator; never convert attention or context into eligibility or adverse action.
roles.failure_state: When source quality, authority, resources, affected-actor identity, or offer terms are incomplete, hold the offer and route the exact gap rather than assigning a score or silent denial.
roles.prohibited_consequence: No punitive place score, insurance action, eligibility decision, award, denial, enforcement, evacuation order, property judgment, resident ranking, or unreviewed external effect.

roles.label: Cold Successor
roles.operating_purpose: Reproduce the canonical place, donor identities, role projections, holds, exports, and handoff law from retained repository objects without inheriting unstated authority.
controls: verify every donor and output digest
rebuild all role projections from a clean root
compare exported and reimported role packets
identify unresolved holds and the only seat allowed to release
roles.reading: The successor projection exposes the complete evidence, authority, failure, export, and handoff graph so continuity does not depend on memory, personality, or a hidden operational shortcut.
safe_actions: replay the deterministic build and identify any digest or contract drift
prepare a bounded continuity report that preserves every unresolved hold and authority limit
roles.authority: The cold successor may inspect, rebuild, compare, and report. It may not release, contact, spend, operate credentials, enter a field site, mutate canonical counts, or inherit another actor's authority.
roles.acceptance: A successor can reproduce all five projections, explain every donor and hold, verify export parity, and identify release authority without relying on undocumented context.
roles.export_contract: Export a cold-successor packet with all role manifests, input and output digests, replay commands, held gates, rollback target, and explicit no-release state.
roles.handoff: Return a verified discrepancy, replay receipt, or bounded continuity question to the accountable functional seat or release authority; never repair evidence or authority by inference.
roles.failure_state: When an input, digest, replay step, export, or authority record is missing, report the exact gap and hold promotion rather than reconstructing the missing fact from remembered program shape.
roles.prohibited_consequence: No silent reconstruction, canonical task closure, provider operation, contact, spend, field action, public deployment, release decision, or inherited external-effect authority.

control_question: Can one canonical place be projected through five genuinely different functional seats while each seat retains distinct evidence, controls, authority, acceptance, export, handoff, failure, and prohibited consequence?
